summary.motive: Exploit man-to-man coverage by pairing a tight shallow-cross Mesh rub with an explosive running back Rail/Wheel route along the boundary.
summary.whyItWorks: In man coverage, the linebacker assigned to the running back must fight through the crossing receiver traffic. The Mesh concept acts as a natural legal pick, allowing the faster running back to achieve unobstructed separation down the boundary.
summary.failureMode: Zone coverage (like Cover 2 or Cover 4) where the boundary cornerback or safety is waiting in the deep half to intercept the wheel throw.

beats.title: Spread 11-Personnel Mesh Alignment
beats.text: Steichen aligns in 11 Gun Spread, isolating boundary matchups while preparing dual shallow crossing routes across the middle.

beats.title: The Free-Release Rail & Mesh Rub
beats.text: RB accelerates freely into the boundary flat, while TE and H execute precise crossing paths at 4 yards to create a wall of traffic in the middle of the field.

beats.title: The Will LB Pick & Boundary Separation
beats.text: Will linebacker is tasked with covering RB in man-to-man, but collides violently with the TE crosser, getting picked and trailing 4 yards behind the wheel.

beats.title: The Teardrop Wheel Touchdown Strike
beats.text: QB holds the single-high safety with his eyes, steps into a pristine pocket, and drops a 25-yard teardrop into the bucket down the boundary to RB for a touchdown.

relations.tell: RB free-releases on boundary rail/wheel route while slot receivers set tight crossing rub.
